entities.name: Armando Falcão
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Armando Ribeiro Falcão was a Brazilian politician. Falcão was born in Fortaleza. He graduated from Federal University Of Rio de Janeiro Faculty Of Law. From 1974 to 1979, he served as Brazil's Justice Minister under former President Ernesto Geisel.
